*   Compute $\rho(r, t)$ (using current $f$ and $u$) [S1].

The claim states to 'Compute ρ(r, t) (using current f and u)'. The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly defines the computation of the residual ρ(r, t) (or ρ(r, τ)) within the algorithms provided. Specifically, in Algorithm 2 (DynART) and Algorithm 3 (PDVC), the residual is computed as the difference between the recorded projections p(r, t) and the projections of the warped volume R_θ(t)[f̃(x, t)], where f̃ is the volume f advected by the displacement field u. For example, Algorithm 3 states: 'ρ(r, t) ← p(r, t) − R_θ(t) [ f̃ ( x, t) ]' and 'f̃( x, t) ← f λ ( x + u( x, t))'. This confirms that ρ is computed using the current volume estimate f and the current displacement field u.
